Silicon 2022; Brown 2018; Dow Corning 2011) 2.7.3 Imports/Exports of Metallurgical-Grade Silicon While China controls more than 80% of mg-Si production (Figure 29), the United States imports mg-Si primarily from Brazil, Canada, Norway, and Australia (U.S. Geological Survey 2025t). Dow Chemical also owns assets in Brazil, which form a primary source of low-boron mg-Si for polysilicon for Dow Chemical and Hemlock production in the United States (Brown 2018). The U.S. reliance on mg-Si imports is less than 50% of apparent consumption (U.S. Geological Survey 2025t). Depending on the purity criteria for mg-Si, 92–110 kt were imported in 2024 (U.S. Geological Survey 2025t; U.S. International Trade Commission 2025a). 42 This report is available at no cost from the National Laboratory of the Rockies (NLR) at www.nlr.gov/publications.
